definitions.gloss: simple, artless, unsophisticated, honest and plain-spoken
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is simple, straightforward, and unpretentious in manner and speech. Often implies rustic honesty without guile or sophistication - a positive quality suggesting genuineness.

examples.japanese: {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has an unpretentious way of speaking.

examples.japanese: {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な{農夫|のうふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{飾|かざ}り{気|け}→飾り気：15202_kazarike⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The plain-spoken farmer expressed his gratitude in unadorned words.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧.

ALTERNATE READINGS: Can also be read as ぼくねつ.

NUANCE: {朴訥|ぼくとつ} has positive connotations - it describes honest simplicity rather than stupidity. It suggests someone who is genuine and unpretentious, often associated with rural or working-class people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧ (simple character)
- {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧ (plain way of speaking)
- {朴訥|ぼくとつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (artless person)
